summary: As Texas AG, Paxton opened a state investigation into pro-Palestinian student walkouts near Dallas and called for firing educators, framing the activism as antisemitism. In October 2026 he vowed to “never stop standing with Israel and the Jewish people.” A July 2026 remark questioning billions sent to Israel alongside other foreign aid complicates the picture slightly, but his overall pattern—state-level suppression of Palestinian solidarity and strong Israel advocacy—draws opposition from Vote for Peace.
